ruleset.name: FormFabricatorReview
ruleset.description: What WordPress.org's plugin reviewers ask for beyond WordPress.Security's sniffs: late escaping with the function that fits the context (LateEscape), request input read as sanitize_*(wp_unslash(...)) in place (RequestInput), and nonce checks no path can skip (NonceShape). Used by .phpcs-review.xml. Dev tooling, never shipped.
